items.title: Voice works only in Chrome; Firefox + Brave fail silently
items.root_cause: ASR is window.SpeechRecognition/webkitSpeechRecognition in public/buzzy/talk.html startListening(). Firefox has no such API. Brave exposes it but returns service-not-allowed (Google speech service blocked by default). startListening used to return silently when SR was absent, so the mic lit up and nothing happened; error codes other than not-allowed were ignored.
shipped: 7403270 explicit unsupported-browser + error-code messages, honest exit from listen mode
<next> voice.note persists the message through paintVoice repaints (paintVoice was wiping it instantly)
e2069ee server ASR: POST /api/buzzy/transcribe (session-gated, raw WAV body, gpt-audio-mini, no new key)
e2069ee client recorder fallback: getUserMedia + ScriptProcessor -> 16k mono WAV -> transcribe -> same turn
7c7570c silence is never a transcript: SILENCE sentinel + refusal filter
b8c74ee client skips upload when RMS saw no speech; server drops meta-answers
feat: §asr_ms recorded with lane='asr' in buzzy_voice_metrics
items.evidence: Prod: transcribe 200 with exact transcript, asr_ms 917-1089 for a 6.5s clip; silence clip -> {"text":""}; unauth -> 401. Browser matrix (authenticated): chrome-natural/brave-natural show 'Mic or speech service blocked'; noSR cases show the recorder taking over. Recorder E2E with a real spoken WAV as the fake mic: chrome 475KB -> correct transcript 1.37s; brave 480KB -> correct transcript 3.11s. Real Firefox (playwright firefox 151, no SpeechRecognition): recorder path opens the mic, posts, handles an empty transcript by re-arming, no JS errors from our code. Timing on a 6.55s utterance + 3s pad: VAD ends the clip 0.88s after speech stops, transcript lands 1.20s after the clip ends (asr_ms 1201). Ops read-back shows lane='asr', asr_ms 978.
items.next: 1) Prove a real Firefox page (install playwright firefox) takes the recorder path without JS errors. 2) Real end-of-speech timing: measure time from 'stop talking' to transcript for a normal 3-5s utterance. 3) Record asr_ms into buzzy_voice_metrics so ops can see it.
items.done_when: Transcript -> SSE audio proven on Chromium and Firefox, or an explicit in-product statement that voice is Chrome/Edge-only with typed chat everywhere.
items.open: A real Firefox microphone on Shane's machine is still unproven (headless fake streams are tone/silence, not speech). Everything else is verified.

items.title: A barge-in lost the head of the interrupting utterance
items.root_cause: The recorder for the interrupting turn starts at DETECTION, not at speech onset: 350 ms reply grace + 3x80 ms loud frames + 80 ms poll, then startListening()/startCapture(). 'Hold on, skip the first one.' reached the transcriber as 'on. Skip the first one.'
shipped: 2593250 mic pre-roll ring (1800 ms) kept while the mic stream is open; preRollTake() seeds startCapture() and startRecording(), trimmed to the first speech (two 30 ms windows over 0.015 RMS, 80 ms lead-in); preRollStop() on listen end / mic release; state().preRollMs + console 'pre ms'

c941650 (live 22:14Z) the ring cannot die quietly: preRollStart() resumes a suspended mic AudioContext BEFORE the reuse check, a 1 s watchdog rebuilds a missing/stalled ring (no frames for 2 s) and resumes it while the mic is open, state().ring exposes {state,frames}, and preRollMs is POSTed to /api/buzzy/voice-metrics and stored (migration 0056, pre_roll_ms) so 0 = head never captured vs >0 = head in the clip

7bad961 the take happens at the gate, not after the hops: bargeArm() snapshots the ring the instant it is certain (preRollPending, 1.5 s freshness), preRollTake keeps a quiet-but-real onset (PRE_ROLL_LOW 0.003) when the 0.015 edge scan starts late, falls back to the gate-vouched 1.5 s window when nothing clears either edge, and never pads digital silence; state() returns preRollWhy (edge|edge-low|gate-tail|no-speech|no-ring|ring-deaf|ring-dead|rate-mismatch) plus ring {peak,last,rebuilds,deaf}; a ring that pumps frames but has only heard LSBs is rebuilt (deaf source node), max 3 times.

b48fcb2 (live 14:24Z) the barge gate votes on the ring: the detector used to own a second AudioContext + MediaStreamSource + AnalyserNode, which can be suspended or left bound to a released stream while the ring keeps hearing the room — on the 9:03 AM 7bad961 walk the ring recorded the interruption at peak 1.0008 and the reply was never cut (no user turn at all). The ring's frame callback now casts the vote (RMS per 42.7 ms frame, 3 consecutive frames > 0.02 after a 350 ms grace, 1200 ms cooldown, one fire per turn); (bargCtx/bargAn are gone). state().gate returns {armed,frames,peak,rms,hits,fires,why,sinceSpeakMs,lastFireAgoMs}.

6f7710a (branch fix/head-floor, NOT deployed) two fixed thresholds were the remaining bug: the 3187 walk kept headMs 249 (= one gate frame + the 80 ms lead, i.e. nothing above the 0.003 low edge earlier in the ring) with leadMs 21, clipPeak 1.001, gain 1 — a real canceller ducked the head below both the absolute low edge and polishSamples' 0.0015 per-sample silence, and the whole-clip lift (peak<0.25) could never fire. Now: low edge = 3x the ring's own 20th-percentile window RMS (floor 0.0004, cap 0.015); head bounded to PRE_ROLL_HEAD_MAX_MS 1200 before the loud onset (earlier is the reply through a leaky canceller); polishSamples(flat, rate, headSamples) trims relative to the clip's own peak and normalises head and body as two regions, lift boundary = the loud onset found INSIDE the head (the ring is taken at the gate, so the head's tail always carries the body's first syllable), 25 ms ramp, 400x cap, no lift within 3x of the body; telemetry gains headGain/splitMs/headPeak/bodyPeak/ringMs/ring (15 x 250 ms of the ring at the take) and state().preRollSamples, because headMs alone cannot separate a dropped head from a head that never reached the ring.
items.evidence: Ops read-back (GET /api/buzzy/voice-metrics?days=1, ops key from the agent-relay service) settles the clip question: client rows 2026-11-11T21:59:33.189Z and 2026-11-12T02:09:45.263Z (the two long-lived virtual-mic walks) both carry pre_roll_ms=null, i.e. zero pre-roll on the turn that transcribed as 'Skip the first one.'; my 22:18:56.542Z walk carries 325 and transcribed verbatim. So the head was missing from the CLIP, not from the transcriber — and preRollTake() returned nothing while the ring was pumping (state().ring frames 3550 -> 7161 across the 9:09 PM walk). 2026-11-12 02:2xZ deploy 7bad961 (BUILDING->SUCCESS 02:28:25Z), served /buzzy/talk.html 272,915 B md5 fae232f2f5bf0bc5bc74750f79eefad0 with markers gate-tail/preRollWhy/edge-low/preRollPending x7. Local proof on the shipped file: preroll-take.test.mjs extracts the real preRollTake and 6/6 pass (edge, edge-low, gate-tail, no-speech, no-ring, recorder-edge); device-shaped rig (Chrome fake capture device fed 10 s digital silence then the hold-on clip, not a stubbed getUserMedia) gives preRollMs 281-311 and clip offset 0.00 vs the source, and the same rig after a 40 s idle still takes 264 ms. 2026-11-12 14:2xZ: 7bad961 failed WORSE than the head: no cut and no turn on the 9:03 AM walk while ring.peak was 1.0008 (bargeCtx/AnalyserNode deaf, ring live). b48fcb2 shipped as SUCCESS 14:24:53Z; served /buzzy/talk 274,910 B = blob 274,849 B + 61 B nav transform, markers bargeFeed x4 / bargeFire x2 / gateFires x3, bargeCtx 0 / bargAn 0. Headless Chrome + fake capture device fed 10 s digital silence then a 3 s 440 Hz burst: gate fires 107 ms after tone onset, audio cut, /api/buzzy/transcribe POSTed, clip 4,060 ms with leadSilence 81 ms (head intact); same rig after the ring was rebuilt 3x and marked deaf (rebuilds 3, deaf true) still fires and transcribes; 20 s of digital silence alone fires 0 (no false cut). 2026-11-12 17:0xZ: abc2ef4 deployed (SUCCESS 17:05:40Z) and the 3187 real-mic walk cut correctly but posted headMs 249 / why edge / leadMs 21 / clipPeak 1.001 / gain 1 and the bubble read 'Skip the first one.' — the head was below both fixed thresholds on that device. 6f7710a: new rig rig-head-floor (head at 0.0008 amp ~0.00057 RMS, 250 ms inter-phrase gap, body 0.4) fails on abc2ef4 (marker absent, headMs 201, why edge, gain 1) and passes on 6f7710a (marker 25 ms, amp 0.3165, headMs 891, why edge-low, headGain 400, clip 3098 ms); rig-ducked-head 0.006, rig-idle-head (52 s), rig-sr-idle-head and gate-head all still pass; tsc/build/inline-block checks clean. Live walk on 6f7710a is the remaining gate.
